notes.title: Update: Operation 5.56 NATO v0.1.19
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players,[/b]
We are excited to present "Operation 5.56 NATO," a major update that introduces new equipment, features, and improvements to enhance your gaming experience! This patch has been carefully crafted to bring fresh content, increased dynamism, and gameplay optimization for more immersive sessions. Here’s what’s in store for you:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Weapons[/b][/h2]
Expand your arsenal with formidable weapons designed for every scenario:

[*] [b]CZ Scorpion[/b] (Chambered in 9x19mm): [i]A compact SMG, perfect for rapid-fire power.[/i]
[*] [b]AUG A2[/b] (Chambered in 5.56x45mm): [i]A reliable bullpup assault rifle, ideal for precise mid-range shooting.[/i]
[*] [b]SA-80[/b] (Chambered in 5.56x45mm): [i]A British Army bullpup assault rifle, powerful and dependable for accurate mid-range fire.[/i]
[*] [b]MP5[/b] (Chambered in 9x19mm): [i]A submachine gun designed for excellent fire rate and maneuverability.[/i]
[*] [b]M2 Flamethrower[/b]: [i]Unleash hell with this incendiary weapon – but watch out, fuel is limited![/i]
[*] [b]SCP-127[/b]: [i]Unique in its kind… this weapon is equipped with "teeth." That's right, a limited 57-tooth magazine.[/i]

[h3][b]New Grenades[/b][/h3]
Bring a new layer of strategy to your battles with these grenades:

[*] Red & White Smoke: Thick and tactical, perfect for concealing your movements.
[*] Flash Grenade: Blind your opponents and create a diversion.

[h3][b]New Feature - Skip Radio Cinematic[/b][/h3]
Because every second counts, you can now skip the radio cinematic and jump straight into the action!

[h3][b]New Achievements[/b][/h3]
Face new challenges and unlock achievements, including the brand-new "Good morning vietnam!" It's your time to earn them all!

[h3][b]New Containment Rooms[/b][/h3]
Explore the new containment zones designed for SCP-7328 and SCP-127.
These rooms bring additional content, new weapons, and extra challenges for the boldest players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png[/img]

[h2][b]Technical Updates[/b][/h2]

[*] Weapon System: Improved for smoother performance, making each shot more satisfying and immersive.
[*] Settings: Updated to provide more options and optimizations for enhanced comfort and customization.
[*] Steam Page: Refreshed to showcase the latest features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png[/img]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]

[*] Overall Optimization: Enhanced performance for a smoother gaming experience.
[*] SCP-939 Attack Animations: Now function correctly, delivering intended damage.
[*] Increased Damage and Health for SCP-939: Get ready for an even tougher challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783309/6e58a7623452e8442f9fab5f3e6905aed32bc612.png[/img]

We hope "Operation 5.56 NATO" adds depth and excitement to your gaming sessions! Thank you for your continuous feedback and support; it’s thanks to you that we keep improving the experience. Have fun, and see you in the game!

- Pixeleur Development Team

notes.title: Pre-Alpha version 0.0.0.18
notes.content:
PATCHNOTE:

Update :

- Slight improvement in the optimization of objects and computers.
- Added blood splatter on SCP-939
- Added footsteps sound for SCP-939
- Added broken glass effect to the flashing lights

notes.title: Patchnotes v0.0.0.17
notes.content:
[b]Update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Slight improvement in light optimization.
[*] SCP-939 instances saved.
[*] Keybinds are now in QWERTY format by default.
[*] Improved flashlight (wider vision).
[*] Improved energy (faster regeneration and slower reduction).
[*] Added player footstep noise
[*] Reduced time delay between each ambient noise. 
[/list]

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed subtitles not translated into English.
[*] Corrected orthographic errors
[*] Character animation corrected.
[*] Keybinds now work correctly in and out of game.
[*] SCP-409 now prevents raising or lowering movement.
[*] Fixed bug where running would become impossible due to low health, then become possible again after game reload.
[*] Gyrophare easier to destroy with P90.
[*] SCP-939 no longer repeats its animation on death.
[/list]
